'''Lythos I''' was a mining [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was tidally locked and extremely [[Temperature/Legends|hot]]. A number of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] stations were built on the planet's night side.<ref name="TEA" />
